newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Polymate debuts at 11.00 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Polymate debuts at 11.00 rgt.

text.p: Polymate Holdings Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange's Second Board on Tuesday at 11.00 ringgit, against an offer price of 5.00 ringgit a share.
At 0134 GMT, the stock was trading at 9.90 ringgit. The maker of plastic products and batteries had offered 4.776 million new shares to the public.
The company's plastic products include water cisterns, furniture and electrical component parts. It also makes automotive batteries.
For the year ending September 30, 1997, Polymate has forecast a pre-tax profit of 12.92 million ringgit or net profit of 9.02 million. It expects net earnings per share of 45.08 cents.

That compares with pre-tax profit of 9.19 million ringgit or net profit of 7.69 million in the year-earlier period. Earnings per share last year was 50.54 cents and turnover totalled 56.06 million ringgit.
